episode_title: Logicalis IoT Trojectory - Episode 20 - Thermal Detection Monitoring for COVID-19

real_qa.q: What is the accuracy level of commercial-grade thermal detection systems for measuring human body temperature?
real_qa.r: Most commercial-grade thermal detection systems are accurate within 0.4 degrees Fahrenheit or Celsius, providing accuracy consistently less than half a degree. This level of precision allows systems to clearly identify if someone has an elevated temperature relevant to health monitoring, such as detecting fever symptoms associated with COVID-19.

real_qa.q: How quickly can thermal detection systems be deployed for fever screening in facilities?
real_qa.r: Deployment speed varies by solution type: cart-based solutions can be deployed within a couple of days, wearable technologies and self-service kiosks can be deployed the same day straight out of the box with no setup required. These kiosks allow individuals to walk up and be scanned without touching anything or requiring an operator present.

real_qa.q: What price ranges exist for different thermal detection system solutions for fever screening?
real_qa.r: Entry-level kiosk solutions range from $6,000 to $8,000. Mid-range video feed-based systems that handle multiple people simultaneously cost $16,000 to $20,000. High-end solutions supporting 30-40 individuals passing simultaneously and operating from 20+ feet distance range from $40,000 to $50,000 and above, with increased camera capability and software features for masking and integration.
